records.excerpt: The official London Borough of Lambeth landlord licence public register provides a postcode search and states that the Housing Act 2004 requires local authorities to maintain a public register of licensed properties, temporary exemption notices and management orders.
records.web_line_scope: official public-register heading, postcode-search control, statutory register statement and update statement
records.record_scope: official publisher identity, public-register purpose and postcode-search interface

records.excerpt: Lambeth Council states that selective licensing applies to privately rented properties in specified wards and provides a postcode-based ward checker; the scheme identifies licensed rented-property context but does not establish an exact parcel or building type.
records.web_line_scope: official scheme purpose, covered property types, phase ward lists and postcode ward-checker section
records.record_scope: official selective-licensing context and interpretation boundary

records.excerpt: Lambeth Council's HMO licensing privacy notice says HMO licence information may be disclosed to the public through the HMO licensing register and describes statutory application and inspection information handled by the council.
records.web_line_scope: official purpose, information-collected and recipients sections
records.record_scope: official disclosure basis and register-publication boundary

records.excerpt: Lambeth Council's website terms require lawful use, note that online services may have their own terms and state that the council website is covered by copyright and the Open Government Licence.
records.web_line_scope: official using-site, online-services and linking/reuse sections
records.record_scope: official terms of use and reuse boundary

records.excerpt: Lambeth Council states that lambeth.gov.uk and its sub-sites are covered by copyright and the Open Government Licence, subject to the stated terms and exclusions.
records.web_line_scope: official copyright ownership and Open Government Licence statement
